title: Night of the Living Dead
synopsis: A cemetery, a farmhouse, a basement argument, and a country radio voice that is finally telling the truth.

nodes.text: A brother teases his sister at a headstone.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Light.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A pale figure stumbles between the stones.

choices.consequence: “Approach” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Reckless.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A head hits a marker with a sound that does not stop.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Drive away.” The story records the instinct as “Smart” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You walk down the porch with both hands up and the sheriff's man, suspicious of nothing in particular, lowers his rifle and lets you live.
You spend the night with Cooper after all, and the radio announces the all clear at noon and a small girl on a stair never quite stops being your nightmare.
You take the only working truck out at dawn and you do not look back, and the radio crackles and the road dust hangs and the country is, briefly, quiet.
